purpose: Ephemeral PostgreSQL oracle for M1 differential validation
discovery_evidence: Saved edb-download-page.html identifies Version16.16 Windows x86-64 link fileid1260670; PostgreSQL Windows page points expert users to these EDB archives.
signature_verification: No detached signature verification; official HTTPS plus publisher SHA256 sidecar.
extraction_safety: Each archive entry resolved beneath the isolated destination; traversal outside it rejected.
server_actual_version: PostgreSQL 16.16, compiled by Visual C++ build 1944, 64-bit
lifecycle: No global installation, PATH edit, Windows service, external listener or production database. Random password passed through transient pwfile/child environment without logging. Cluster stopped and owned path removed after smoke.
discovered_hazard: Windows pg_ctl startup with captured output pipes kept inherited handles alive in the server. Fixed by DEVNULL stdin/stdout/stderr for startup, with a dedicated server log.
version_specific_note: Database collation read from pg_database.datcollate; current_setting('lc_collate') is not recognized on this tested runtime.
